 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Green Bay Packers WR Christian Watson (ankle) was a limited participant in practice Thursday, Oct. 22.
 SOURCE: Packers.com 
 Why it Matters: Watson is expected to be ready for the Week 7 contest, but check on his status after Friday's practice just to be safe. Watson has been a big-play weapon all year, scoring six touchdowns in six games and topping 140 yards twice. Facing a struggling Detroit defense, Watson could deliver a WR1 performance.
